summary: Equinor ASA furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing open-market repurchases under the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back, announced 22 July 2026 and running 23 July to no later than 26 October 2026. From 21-25 September 2026 the company bought 701,262 own shares at a weighted average of NOK 405.9719, paying NOK 284,692,637.21, bringing accumulated tranche purchases to 6,269,053 shares at NOK 394.7910 for NOK 2,474,965,565.91. Total treasury holdings reach 20,903,788 shares, 0.87% of capital (0.41% excluding the share savings programme). What to watch: buy-back pace versus the tranche cap and any fourth-tranche extension.
